housing: Chandler renters mostly live in stucco single-family homes in HOA communities and in large apartment complexes, many near tech employers.

climate: Test the air conditioning and photograph the outdoor unit; summer highs often pass 110°F, so a broken AC is an urgent repair.
fact: Arizona law sets the rules for Chandler rentals, and many homes are also governed by HOA rules that tenants must follow.
